entries.name: Kyrn
entries.look: Kyrn is the facility operative who returned to Remi's cell, demanded that she kill the Oracle and sever the plane, and melted Mossy when Remi objected. He is not the same as the imp retrieval force; he controls the custody environment the imps use. Kyrn emerged from the shadows of Remi's cell like a specter given flesh and malice, his presence casting an even darker pallor over the already grim surroundings. entries.name: Merric
entries.look: Merric is an axe-wielding sheep encountered during the Shadow Estate sequence. He behaved as if he was already part of the team, then failed Markop’s identity check by calling him “Centerus,” then accepted the correction not by apologizing but by joining the team for real. Waluigi respects this recruitment method because it is fast, confusing, and paperwork-light. Merric entered the record during the Shadow Estate upper-floor chaos as a sheep with an axe and enough confidence to critique Markop's violence. entries.name: Randell
entries.look: Randell followed Remi and Eager back to Tymnas's cottage and claimed he had authorized both the trampoline and the earlier capture operation. Markop called him a liar. The cottage initially barred him because nobody had invited him inside; an imp pulled from the broom closet then granted permission, exploiting the threshold rule. entries.name: Rattles
entries.look:
Rattles is a skeleton recruited from a servant closet who wants to turn back time and regain his original flesh-and-bones body, not a replacement. He speaks with deeply skeleton-appropriate timing, joined the party during the Shadow Estate servant corridor sequence, and survived the rooftop escape by grabbing onto Remi during Feather Fall. Rattles first entered the record during the servant corridor investigation, where he was found with an antique frog and a goblet. He wanted his old body back specifically, which Waluigi finds unusually precise for a skeleton in a closet.

entries.name: Tanukiburt
entries.look: Tanukiburt is the newest and least welcome answer to the Toadburt question: a Tanuki-shaped or Toadburt-shaped problem found at the master-bedroom portal circle alongside Mystic Morel and the injured real Toadburt. Waluigi does not yet know the full mechanics. Waluigi does know that if a person named Tanukiburt is standing next to the real Toadburt at the only exit, the correct response is screaming followed by tactical planning. entries.name: The Oracle
entries.look: The Oracle — The Metaphysical Custodian of Raventree Manor The Oracle is not a person. It is a role, a function, a custodian of bleeding timelines wearing the face of whoever was convenient when the job needed filling. Waluigi cannot determine the correct pronoun and the Oracle has not volunteered one. Survived a bullet to the brain by checkpointing reality. Maintains flesh vats. Warned Archie Miser that he was absorbing too much power during the transit ritual and then allowed the ritual to proceed. Granted Markop titan-scale growth during the Spider Grove battle. entries.name: The Plant of the Manor
entries.look: The overgrowth's masterpiece: a plant that wore Lady Aurelian Corvinarus well enough to hold a conversation over cold tea, run a household, and issue standing orders to guards who never questioned them. Confronted in its own sanctuary, it explained its plan - collapse the manor, let trees grow in the ruins - took a bowl of Red's poisoned kitchen slop to the chest, and came apart into something with roots in its eye sockets.
